7.7.11 StateMachine State notification
As
State Management StateMachine States
reflect the current functionality of
a
Machine

Machine
(e.g. Fire-
wall, SystemHealthManagement, ...) it shall be possible to make the
StateMachine
States
available to them. Therefore, it shall be possible to configure a
StateMachi-
neNotification
service interface (modelled as meta-class
ServiceInterface
)
for a
StateMachine
.
